title: A simpler way to validate external image rules
body: Our team manually checks image configuration in every environment because deployment failures are difficult to reproduce. A preflight workflow would reduce this workaround.

title: Support a reproducible API integration diagnostic
body: We repeatedly write custom scripts to isolate client configuration problems. A small diagnostic workflow would help teams see missing configuration before deployment.

title: Expose deployment workflow failure context
body: Our CI pipeline needs manual log collection when Compose startup fails. We currently stitch logs from multiple commands as a workaround.

title: A guided configuration migration preview
body: Migration setup is tedious and manual for small teams. We need a safe preview before changing production configuration.

title: Extension compatibility smoke test
body: Extension authors run custom scripts every release to check compatibility. A shared test workflow could automate the repeated integration work.

title: Improve diagnostics for slow extension activation
body: Debugging activation timing is painful because teams have to manually collect traces from several tools.
